Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<iostream>
#include<vector>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    void sortColors(vector<int>& nums) {
        /* 用两个指针 zero, two作为分隔板. zero: 使得所有在zero左边的元素都为0; two, 使得所有在two右边的元素都为2. 
        * 另外始终让让遍历的指针i指向两个分隔板之间的部分, 即始终保持i <= two 和 i >= zero
        */
        const int len = nums.size();
        int zero = 0, two = len - 1;
        int i = 0;
        while (i <= two)  /* 始终保持i <= two */
        {
            if (nums[i] == 0) 
            {
                swap(nums[i], nums[zero]);
                zero++;
            }
            else if (nums[i] == 2) 
            {
                swap(nums[i], nums[two]);
                two--;
            }
            else i++;
            i = max(zero, i);  /* 始终保持 i >= zero */
        }
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<int> nums = {2,0,2,1,1,0};
    sol.sortColors(nums);
    for (auto &num : nums)
        cout << num << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
